newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money steady at 3.10/3.13 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money steady at 3.10/3.13 pct.

text.p: German call money rates were steady at 3.10/3.13 percent on Friday and dealers predicted rates would remain firm above the three percent repo rate in coming days.

Commercial banks's effective deposits at the central bank totalled 39.1 billion marks on Thursday, down from Wednesday's 40.0 billion marks, and the average for the month through Thursday eased to 41.4 billion marks from 41.6 billion.
Borrowings from the bank's Lombard facility totalled about 100 million marks.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average (FIONA) was calculated at 3.14300 percent, up from 3.13433 percent on Thursday.
